description: This Java source file defines the OperationEventNotificationEvent class, which extends ClusterCommandEvent and models a specific Zigbee operation event notification related to door lock states. It constructs a command payload indicating lock/unlock status and references external Zigbee device and cluster classes.

classes.name: OperationEventNotificationEvent
classes.description: Represents an operation event notification for a Zigbee door lock, indicating whether it is locked or unlocked, and constructs the associated command payload.

methods.name: OperationEventNotificationEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with cluster information and lock state.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Generates a byte array payload representing the operation event, including source and lock state codes.

calls: super(cluster.getEui64(), MockZigbeeDevice.HA_PROFILE, cluster.getEndpointId(), cluster.getClusterId(), cluster.isServer(), false, 0, OPERATION_EVENT_NOTIFICATION_COMMAND_ID)
